name: Puddles Ironbill
bio: Nobody asks what is inside the mech either.
notes: New model 2026-11-25 (owner: "many are replacements for what we currently have"; id, name and place kept, as Thornweaver's and Anoobys's swaps). Juice's model until 2026-11-25 ("gere com as imagens abaixo por favor", Meshy Community CC0) no longer ships (a community model, not the owner's: owner, 2026-11-25, only the owner's own retired models stay as MapMaker figures). Drive intake of 2026-11-25 ("duck mech fps rigged", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Licence: Meshy, owned: the owner's own Meshy model (owner, 2026-11-25: "all are the owner's own Meshy creations"; standing rule since 2026-11-22). Hold (2026-11-25): the round mech's arms are short for its width, so its long guns sit 12 cm further out along the barrel, 3 cm lower and 15 cm in toward its middle (`fixes.hold`), which puts the support hand on a rifle's handguard (it was 17 cm out of reach: e2e characters4). Renamed Puddles Ironbill (owner, 2026-11-25: Juice renamed to a fun personal name that fits the new model, a duck in a mech; was Juice).
